title: Marin data source registry
notes: Do not rename or reuse an id. Set status to superseded when a newer edition replaces a source.
sha256 is the hash of the file when it was hashed. If the file at url changes, the hash no longer matches and data extracted from it may be out of date.

One record per source PDF. Apps refer to a source by id. A source with a url is not stored here. An internal source (access: internal) has no url and no stored file, and must never be linked from a public page.

sources.title: County of Marin Proposed Budget FY 2026-28
sources.edition: Final, including the Board of Supervisors revision of 8 June 2026 (file revised 14 July 2026)
sources.notes: Descriptions, missions, program descriptions, fund descriptions, contacts, and current supervisor names were extracted from the County budget book. No missing values were inferred.

sources.title: County of Marin FY 2027-31 Proposed Capital Improvement Plan
sources.publisher: County of Marin Department of Public Works

extraction.note: Attachment E, CIP book. Figures are read from the tables on pages 19, 21 and 24-27; the other pages are narrative and images.
notes: Figures are whole dollars as the book prints them.
Projects are listed as the book lists them; the book names no department or fund for a project.
On a project, funding in the plan is its prior approvals plus the five programmed years; programmed is the five years only.
A project's cost estimate is its funding in the plan plus the additional funds still needed.
extraction.statedProjectCountNote: The number of projects the book's text gives (page 4); its tables list a different number.
